text:
ben: Kicking off staged rollout for inference-service v2.4.0-alpha. Plan: 3% -> 15% -> 40% with 8m waits (EU waits 12m). Change window 01:30-03:30 UTC. Starting 3% canary in us-east-1 now. @sre-oncall @linda pls watch logs and user-facing error rates.

dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] initiating canary: inference-service v2.4.0-alpha -> us-east-1 canary (3%). Start=2026-04-02T01:32:11Z. Instances: i-use-11,i-use-12. Traffic: v2.4.0-alpha=3%, v2.3.9=97%.

linda: noticing elevated 504 gateway timeouts hitting api-gateway for requests routed to i-use-12. 504 rate ~0.7% (baseline 0.03%). Logs show repeated tokenizer exception: "UnknownTokenError: token id -1" and then request hangs until timeout.

ron: vmstat on i-use-12 shows steady <10% free memory and swap thrash spikes. Also repeated logs: "tokenizer: fallback -> byte-level decode path" which correlates with extra CPU work.

ben: hmm. is this a model artifact or a packaging change? did the tokenizer pin change between v2.3.9 and v2.4.0-alpha?

sre-oncall: initial hypothesis: tokenizer binary incompatible with existing KV-cache entries leading to fallback decode and CPU blowup. Recommend HOLD and pin region back to stable until we can confirm.

kevin: quick check: v2.4.0-alpha includes upgraded tokenizers (byte-pair merge table bumped). If old cached requests still use previous token ids, fallback code path triggers. We should avoid user traffic until a compatibility layer is added.

ben: consensus seems HOLD. I'll pin us-east-1 to v2.3.9 and pause further ramps. Executing graceful shift to stable.

ben: ```
/deploy pin --region=us-east-1 --service=inference --version=v2.3.9 --reason="tokenizer incompat + 504 spike"
```

dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] pin command accepted. Pausing rollout, disabling automated percent ramps. Shifting canary traffic off v2.4.0-alpha in us-east-1. Marking rollout=PAUSED.

dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] pin complete: us-east-1 pinned to v2.3.9. v2.4.0-alpha instances cordoned. Audit: cmd=pin, actor=ben, reason=tokenizer incompat + 504 spike, ts=2026-04-02T01:41:12Z.

ops-bot: Observability: 504 rate in us-east-1 falling 0.7% -> 0.05% over 3m after pin. CPU on i-use-12 decreasing.

linda: after pin, 504s back to baseline (0.04%) and p95 latency reverted near baseline. I captured sample traces and failing inputs; will attach to INC-2026-58.

ron: creating a reproducible job in staging that replays the affected prompts with warm KV-cache + mixed version clients to trigger the tokenizer fallback.

kevin: I'll prepare a compatibility shim that maps legacy token ids to new ones and turn on a toggle for alpha until we can release a proper migration. If we patch quickly we can attempt a limited retry in the second half of the window.

sre-oncall: create an incident and tag infra/testing. We should also add a rollback entry in the release notes explaining the PAUSE and pin action.

ben: opened INC-2026-58: "tokenizer compat -> 504s us-east-1 during v2.4.0-alpha canary". Rollout state=PAUSED, pinned_regions=[us-east-1], assigned kevin/linda/ron.

ben: will update the release changelog: mark v2.4.0-alpha as PAUSED pending tokenizer compat fix, include rollback rationale and link to INC-2026-58. Keeping change window held until 03:30 UTC in case we need a hotfix.

kevin: will update thread when shim is ready for internal staging test. No further ramps until we have reproducible test results.

ben: thanks all. Closing here for now; re-open if the incident requires an emergency patch deploy in the window.
